items.title: LEGO City Police Mini Movies Compilation
items.description:
The original six episodes of the LEGO City Police series. Original video was in HD, but this copy is SD.
Includes Hot Chase, Rocket Cash, Cash Splash, Crooks Everywhere, Money Tree and Gold Run.

items.title: A BUNCH of 2000s Kids' Commercials
items.description:
A collection of commercials aimed at children that aired throughout the 2000s, compiled by Youtube user Alanna Grace. The commercials are:

- Spongebob Squarepants DVD Collection
- Toontown Online: "Of course, have fun"
- Kid Cuisine Cheese Pizza Painter: "Grocery Store Freezer"<

items.title: Building Lego City 4432 Garbage Truck
items.description:
This is a mirror for youtube video with original file format that you can download!

In this video I build a Lego Garbage truck. 

It is model 4432 and the model is from 2012.

Belongs to the LEGO CITY sets and Traffic.

Contains 208 pieces and 2 minifigs.
